title: What is a Demand Coop
summary: This article from Cahootz Coops explains what a Demand Cooperative (Demand Coop) is — a member-owned business model where members collectively negotiate better prices and access to goods/services by pooling their purchasing power. It explores how this model differs from traditional co-ops and why it creates value for members through collective demand aggregation.
problem_solved: Explains how consumers can leverage collective buying power to access better pricing and terms through cooperative membership
why_valuable: Provides clarity on an alternative business model that empowers community members to save money and gain negotiating leverage through collaboration
